concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish scalar quantities from vector quantities with examples.
Describe position and displacement vectors and the equality of vectors.

topics.title: Multiplication by real numbers; addition and subtraction of vectors

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the effect of multiplying a vector by a real number.
Add and subtract vectors graphically using the triangle and parallelogram methods and identify the null vector.

topics.title: Resolution of vectors and analytical addition

concepts.learning_objective: Resolve a vector into rectangular components using unit vectors.
Find the magnitude and direction of a resultant analytically, including the law of cosines.

topics.title: Position, velocity and acceleration in a plane

concepts.learning_objective: Define average and instantaneous velocity in a plane and relate velocity to the tangent to the path.
Define average and instantaneous acceleration in a plane in component form.

topics.title: Motion in a plane with constant acceleration

concepts.learning_objective: Apply the vector equations of motion for constant acceleration as two independent one-dimensional motions.
Show that the path of a projectile is a parabola and analyse its components of motion.
Calculate time of flight, maximum height and horizontal range of a projectile.
Derive and apply the expression for centripetal acceleration in uniform circular motion.
Relate angular speed, time period, frequency and linear speed.
